title: Connector-neutral security/data-flow descriptors are treated as executable runtime cases
title_de: Connector-neutrale Security-Data-Flow-Deskriptoren werden als ausführbare Runtime-Fälle behandelt
security_assessment: No production exploit is claimed. The affected security boundary is the Framework case-schema path from trusted YAML metadata into connector runtime materialization and evidence promotion. The remedy must preserve fail-closed rejection of incomplete executable cases and must not invent connector rules or results.
security_invariant: A connector-neutral descriptor without a connector-owned rule never reaches a connector runtime, cannot be rendered as executable in a force-all report, and cannot be promoted to PASS. The normal non-empty rules requirement remains mandatory for materializable cases.
sink: Framework runner selection and case_cli materialization; runtime matrix report classification
protocol: Framework case-schema validation and Parent verified runtime matrix discovery
profile: The original Parent PR #74 failure used Framework revision a7ebf5a1d9cad2b0a65a7603476a1434fdb16cf6; its repair is merged in Framework master de705a5efb872f95f010346fe2e6143c88876ad4 and already adopted by Parent master through PR #126
observed_behavior: The Parent PR #74 exact runtime producer prepared Apache and NGINX, then Framework force-all discovery failed with ValueError: case requires rules for a security-data-flow descriptor. All 15 descriptors lack connector-owned rules, and their normalized security-data-flow capability was not in the runner allowlist.
observed_behavior_de: Der Exact-Parent-#74-Runtime-Producer bereitete Apache und NGINX vor und scheiterte anschließend in der Framework-Force-All-Discovery mit ValueError: case requires rules für einen Security-Data-Flow-Deskriptor. Alle 15 Deskriptoren besitzen keine connector-eigenen Regeln, und ihre normalisierte Capability security-data-flow fehlte im Runner-Allowlist.
expected_behavior: Connector-neutral former-XFAIL connector-gap descriptors with runtime_verified false must be represented explicitly as non-materializable metadata, remain visible but non-promotable, and never enter connector runtime materialization. Materializable cases must still require non-empty rules.
expected_behavior_de: Connector-neutrale Former-XFAIL-Connector-Gap-Deskriptoren mit runtime_verified false müssen explizit als nicht materialisierbare Metadaten dargestellt werden, sichtbar aber nicht hochstufbar bleiben und niemals die Connector-Runtime-Materialisierung erreichen. Materialisierbare Fälle müssen weiterhin nichtleere Regeln verlangen.
impact: Fresh legitimate Parent PR #74 runtime evidence is blocked. Treating these descriptors as executable or solving the failure with placeholder rules would create a misleading security result; no runtime outcome is currently claimed.
impact_de: Frische legitime Parent-PR-#74-Runtime-Evidence ist blockiert. Die Behandlung dieser Deskriptoren als ausführbar oder die Lösung mit Platzhalterregeln würde ein irreführendes Security-Ergebnis erzeugen; derzeit wird kein Runtime-Ergebnis behauptet.
preconditions: Framework revision a7ebf5a1d9cad2b0a65a7603476a1434fdb16cf6 is selected by Parent PR #74.
FORCE_ALL_CASES is enabled for the Parent runtime matrix discovery.
The security-data-flow corpus contains connector-neutral former-XFAIL connector-gap descriptors without rules.
reproduction: Inspect GitHub Actions Parent PR #74 run 30205593649, job 89802976898, where case_cli rejects request_body_limit_exceeded.yaml with case requires rules after native preparation succeeds.

Before remediation, run FORCE_ALL_CASES=1 python3 tests/runners/case_cli.py list-cases --repo-root . --framework-root . --connector apache --scope all in the Framework root and observe the missing-rules schema rejection.
Audit tests/cases/security-data-flow/**/*.yaml and observe 15 connector-gap former-XFAIL descriptors with runtime_verified false and no rules.

evidence.command: Focused Framework runner/CLI/report-generator tests, direct force-all list-cases discovery, syntax compilation, descriptor validation, documentation checks, exact PR #51 delivery/check-rollup readback, and direct SonarQube Cloud PR issue/measure readback

python -m unittest discover -s tests/security_regression -p test_security_data_flow_case_schema.py -q; python -m unittest discover -s tests/security_regression -p test_generate_case_matrix_sonar.py -q; python ci/checks/security/check-security-data-flow-cases.py
evidence.summary: The Framework-owned schema and report controls are present and pass on current master 47e50e7bc43ba7a3b5bad1a9448111794f664cc0. The remaining required proof is explicitly Parent PR #74 exact-head producer, strict terminal gate, SonarQube Cloud, review, and protected integration evidence.

root_cause: The runner assumes every YAML case is materializable and applies its normal rules/request/expectation schema to connector-neutral inventory descriptors. The Framework schema lacks an explicit non-materializable state and its normalized capability allowlist omits security-data-flow.
root_cause_de: Der Runner nimmt jeden YAML-Fall als materialisierbar an und wendet seinen normalen Rules-/Request-/Expectation-Schema-Contract auf connector-neutrale Inventar-Deskriptoren an. Dem Framework-Schema fehlt ein expliziter nicht materialisierbarer Zustand, und seinem normalisierten Capability-Allowlist fehlt security-data-flow.
proposed_remediation: Add a constrained runtime_materializable boolean to the Framework schema. Only false for former-XFAIL connector-gap cases with capabilities.runtime_verified exactly false may bypass executable request/rules validation; exclude it from force-all selection, reject direct materialization, classify it NOT_EXECUTABLE/non-promotable in reports, and add the normalized capability token.
proposed_remediation_de: Dem Framework-Schema ein eingeschränktes Boolean runtime_materializable hinzufügen. Nur false für Former-XFAIL-Connector-Gap-Fälle mit capabilities.runtime_verified exakt false darf die ausführbare Request-/Rules-Validierung umgehen; von Force-All-Auswahl ausschließen, direkte Materialisierung abweisen, in Reports als NOT_EXECUTABLE/nicht hochstufbar klassifizieren und das normalisierte Capability-Token ergänzen.
acceptance_criteria: All 15 security-data-flow descriptors set runtime_materializable false and retain former_xfail true, status connector-gap, and capabilities.runtime_verified false.
Any materializable case without non-empty rules is still rejected.
An active case cannot opt into the non-materializable contract.
Force-all discovery excludes non-materializable descriptors and direct materialization rejects them.
The report generator marks them NOT_EXECUTABLE and non-promotable even in a force-all snapshot.
Focused tests, Framework PR #51 hosted CI/SonarQube/review/protected integration, and the adopted Parent #74 exact-head producer with strict terminal gate all pass.

Update the existing Parent #74 branch from Parent master containing the adopted Gitlink, then rerun its exact-head producer and strict gate.

A non-materializable former-XFAIL connector-gap descriptor is excluded from force-all discovery.
Direct materialization of a non-materializable descriptor fails.

No risk is accepted.

Es wird kein Risiko akzeptiert.
